verdicts.reason: A rearranges the headline into four large, well-weighted lines that use the portrait width, with the CTA grouped below on the same center axis. Its only flaws are minor: the block sits low, with about 170px above the headline but only about 50px below the CTA, and 'Bubbles,' stands alone on the first line. B keeps the banner's line breaks at a timid size jammed into the top, leaves a large unexplained gap between the headline and the CTA, and leaves the bottom ~35% of the canvas empty, so it looks lopsided and unfinished.
